finding_summary: The analysed homepage's final response was observed over HTTP rather than HTTPS.
business_impact: Serving the homepage without HTTPS removes TLS transport protection for that response and can trigger browser security indicators.
recommended_action: Serve the public homepage over HTTPS and redirect the HTTP entry point to an HTTPS final response.
limitation: This observation covers only the analysed homepage response and does not establish the TLS configuration, certificate quality or security posture of the entire site.
